description: Deterministic mapping from (module status, validated findings) to an adjudicated light. Pilot: displayed as 'shadow light' only; original module lights are never replaced. Rules are evaluated in order; the first whose 'when' holds decides. Interpreted by mc_shadow_light() in scripts/_validate.R.

when_vocabulary.module_status_not: module status differs from this value
when_vocabulary.n_findings: number of valid findings plus unadjudicated candidates equals this value
when_vocabulary.any: at least one finding matches one of the listed matchers
when_vocabulary.all: every finding matches one of the listed matchers (and there is at least one)
when_vocabulary.matcher: object with optional verdict / severity / coverage arrays; all given keys must match

light_vocabulary.inherit_original: the original module light, unless it is listed in 'never', in which case 'fallback'

rules.why: A failed or skipped module is 'could not check', never a clean result.
Confirmed issues stay visible even under partial coverage.
Unresolved, unchecked or partially covered items can never become green; the original light stands unless it was green.
No candidates and no sweep findings: the agent added nothing, so the original light stands.
Every candidate adjudicated as not an issue (or not applicable) with complete coverage.
